address: 380 Zhongmei Street, West District, Taichung, Taiwan
bio: The push cart out front turns back the clock and the retro vibe is pursued indoors. For over 10 years, the owner-chef has been making fish balls, wontons and sauces from scratch. He orders his noodles from his favourite shop in Shuinan Market because of their bouncy texture. Purists should try noodles tossed in scallion oil for its simple, but addictive aromas. Marlin fish ball soup with salted potherb mustard is another best-seller.
